title: ChroPack - ProteinA/G
author: Alexandra Ehl
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.72phqdn
materials: Do you want to purify antibodies or sanitize your column? Please choose below.

steps.title: Connect column and initial water wash
steps.instruction: Connect the ChroPack Protein A/G column to the FPLC system, set the flow rate to 1 bed volume per minute, and wash the column with 5 bed volumes of deionized water; a dry column may be connected directly and air will be expelled through the bottom outlet.

steps.title: Equilibrate column with wash buffer
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the column by passing 5 to 10 bed volumes of wash buffer through it at a flow rate of 1 bed volume per minute.

steps.title: Prepare and load sample
steps.instruction: Adjust the sample pH to 6–8 and NaCl concentration to 150–300 mM; add 1/11 volume of either 10× PBS or 0.5 M Tris with 2 M NaCl (pH 8.0). If yield is low, modify pH by adding sodium acetate buffer (to lower) or phosphate buffer (to raise). Remove particulate matter by centrifugation or filtration through a 0.45 µm filter. Load the prepared sample onto the column; for slow or weak‑binding antibodies, collect the flow‑through and reload it.

steps.title: Wash column after binding
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 10 to 20 bed volumes of wash buffer at 1 BV/min, keeping the flow‑through and wash fractions for later analysis (e.g., SDS‑PAGE). If unspecific hydrophobic or ionic interactions are observed, include up to 1 % Tween‑20 and/or up to 0.5 M NaCl in the wash buffer.

steps.title: Elute bound protein
steps.instruction: Elute the bound protein by applying 10 bed volumes of elution buffer at 1 BV/min and collect fractions of 0.5 to 1 bed volume each.

steps.title: Neutralize eluate
steps.instruction: Add neutralization solution (1 M Tris‑HCl, pH 8.5) to the eluate at a ratio of 100 µL neutralization solution per 900 µL eluate.

steps.title: Post‑elution column cleaning
steps.instruction: Wash the column successively with 5 bed volumes of elution buffer, then 5 bed volumes of wash buffer, then 5 bed volumes of deionized water. Follow with 5 bed volumes of 20 % ethanol or wash buffer containing 0.05 % (w/v) sodium azide. Close the top lid, then the bottom stopper, and store the column at room temperature or at 4–8 °C.

steps.title: Flush column before next use
steps.instruction: Reconnect the column to the FPLC system, set flow rate to 1 BV/min, and flush sequentially with 5 bed volumes of water, 5 bed volumes of elution buffer, and 5 bed volumes of wash buffer (without urea).

steps.title: Sanitization flush
steps.instruction: Flush the column with 5 bed volumes of sanitization solution, stop the pump, and let the column stand for 1 hour.

steps.title: Final wash and storage
steps.instruction: Flush with 5 bed volumes of PBS wash buffer containing 0.05 % (w/v) sodium azide, disconnect the column, close it, and store at 4 °C or at room temperature. Wait at least 12 hours before the next purification.
